=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 3 (lines ~265-268; intake.sh 969-988) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH is assigned only for phase_failure/autofix_failure/workflow_run, not validation_failure, so the Phase 1 compare aborts under set -u or always skips.
  WHY: G3 never fires for the #8182 validation_failure scenario; severity disagreement (BLOCKER from qwen, MAJOR from others), highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 Closing bullet, D9, Risks (workflow_failure_heal.py 4855-5013) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: budget_decision counts not_planned-closed heals in prior_same_fp/closed_lineage, so repeated source-resolved closes drive lineage_cap escalation.
  WHY: A person must intervene after about 3 cycles, contradicting the plan's goal.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 steps 3-4 (lines ~367, 375; queue.sh 36, 164) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The queue accepts only intake/recovery-scan job values and fails open. The plan names no job value and does not list the queue script, so the scan runs unlocked or reuses recovery-scan.
  WHY: An intake occurrence can land between the scan's re-read and its close PATCH, so the race mitigation does not hold.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 close sequence (lines ~368-378) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not ensure the ai:heal-source-resolved label exists or stop the PATCH when the label write fails.
  WHY: The issue closes without the label and the poller's not_planned arm parks the hold with a CRITICAL page.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 (lines ~400-401) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: integration_checked_head is recorded before the compare, so a failed compare still marks the head checked.
  WHY: The hold never retries that head until the branch advances or the hold expires.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 2 (lines ~388-397; poll_process.sh 15193-15198) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The integration head is read after dispatch rather than the head the run checked out.
  WHY: A commit merged in between enters the baseline unvalidated and is never re-validated.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:§15 budget (lines 73-81) vs Phase 1 step 8 (lines ~281-285) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The §15 budget omits Phase 1's poller-side compare/<fix>...<pin> GET per held project per tick.
  WHY: Per-tick API cost is understated; severity disagreement (NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, MAJOR from the others), highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 "Own budget", steps 2-3, Data Model (lines ~135, 395-405, 430-435) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The validation_harness_integration_resumes counter has no specified storage, reset, or persistence, and integration_checked_head persistence via post_state_comment is unspecified.
  WHY: The cap is either unbounded or a lifetime limit, and a new hold inherits the old count.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Risks line 464 (queue best-effort) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The risk bullet claims the queue prevents a race, but the queue fails open, can be disabled, and the scan has its own concurrency group.
  WHY: An occurrence can land on a closed heal issue, so the protection is only best-effort.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 steps 3, 4, 6 (workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml 51-56, 89-90) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: workflow_dispatch requires payload_json and the intake job runs for every non-schedule event, so the scan cannot be dispatched alone.
  WHY: The stated dispatch entry point and its test are unusable as written; severity disagreement (NIT from three reviewers, MAJOR from gemini), highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 4/5 (lines ~272-310; intake.sh 3006-3027) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Only the ${PROGRESS_BRANCH} sentence is replaced, leaving other branch-specific wording (lines 3010-3013, 3025, 3026) saying the fix is on stable.
  WHY: The comment, log and Telegram message are misleading for a main-only fix.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3(c) (~line 364) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The anchor workflow_failure_heal.py:184 should be 186 (VALIDATION_WRAPPER_WORKFLOW_FILES).
  WHY: The implementer lands on unrelated content.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 2 (lines ~245-260) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The switch helper block anchor 213-243 in workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh is off (about 223-244).
  WHY: The anchor points to unrelated code.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 6 (line ~410; README ~3904) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: README.md ~3904 is the VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED=false bullet, not a VALIDATION_HARNESS_HOLD reason list.
  WHY: The implementer must invent a placement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "four independent phases, each behind a default-on switch"; the §15 budget must account for every new API call
  expected_change_site: §15 GitHub API budget in docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md (lines 73-81) and Phase 1 step 8
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Phase 1's poller-side compare/<fix>...<pin> GET from validation_harness_hold_tick step 3 is not budgeted, though Phase 4's poller compare is, and the helper cache is per poller process.
- requirement: Phase 3 scan runs "hourly and on dispatch" (workflow_dispatch) with a test that the mode runs on workflow_dispatch
  expected_change_site: Phase 3 steps 3, 4, 6 and .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml dispatch input handling
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: workflow_dispatch requires payload_json and the intake job runs for every non-schedule event, so the plan adds no dispatch mode and does not gate intake away for the scan.
- requirement: Phase 4 "Own budget": validation_harness_integration_resumes counter, cap VALIDATION_HARNESS_INTEGRATION_MAX_RESUMES default 2 per hold
  expected_change_site: Phase 4 step 1 and Data Model in docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The counter's storage location, reset, and behavior across hold re-entry are not specified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: Under set -euo pipefail it aborts as unbound, or the check always skips with default_branch_unavailable, so G3 never fires.

- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Constraints, §15 GitHub API bullets | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The anchor workflow_failure_heal.py:184 should be 186.
  WHY: Documentation accuracy only.

  Requirement: Phase 3 says the scan runs "hourly and on dispatch" and tests that the mode runs on workflow_dispatch.
  Expected change site: Phase 3 steps 3, 4, 6 and workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml dispatch input handling.
  Evidence of absence: workflow_dispatch requires payload_json and the intake job runs for every non-schedule event, so the scan cannot be dispatched alone.
